name: Grok 4 Fast

lifecycle.note: grok-4-fast-reasoning and grok-4-fast-non-reasoning retired from the xAI API; requests are served by grok-4.3.

replacedBy.note: The reasoning slug redirects to grok-4.3 with low reasoning effort, the non-reasoning slug with reasoning effort none.

retired.note: Effective 12:00 PM PT on the xAI API.

relations.note: Editorial link along the cost-efficient tier: the announcement compares Grok 4 Fast with Grok 3 Mini and says it builds on learnings from Grok 4, without naming a predecessor or a derivation method.

summary.text: Grok 4 Fast is an xAI reasoning model that xAI describes as cost-efficient, released on 19 September 2025 in the Grok apps, including for free users, and on the xAI API with a 2-million-token context window. One set of weights serves both reasoning and non-reasoning responses, offered on the API as two model ids; both were retired on 15 May 2026.

changes.text: Reasoning and non-reasoning modes run on the same model weights, steered by the system prompt, instead of separate models.
Trained end to end with tool-use reinforcement learning to decide when to call tools such as code execution and web or X search.

sources.locator: Native Tool Use with SOTA Search

changes.text: Offered to all Grok users including free users; xAI says this gave free users its latest model without restrictions for the first time.

sources.locator: Grok 4 Fast in grok.com, iOS, and Android apps

changes.text: xAI reports results comparable to Grok 4 with substantially fewer thinking tokens on average.

features.note: One set of weights handles reasoning and non-reasoning modes, steered by the system prompt; offered on the API as two model ids.

features.note: Trained end to end with tool-use reinforcement learning, including web and X search.

sources.locator: Grok 4 Fast in grok.com, iOS, and Android apps; Grok 4 Fast on OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, and the xAI API

notes: One unified model offered on the API as grok-4-fast-reasoning and grok-4-fast-non-reasoning (aliases); the announcement also uses grok-4-fast for its LMArena entry. The announcement names OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway as channels; these are aggregators, not recorded as cloud-partner. The xAI API release notes have no entry for Grok 4 Fast. The grok.com release notes mention Grok 4 Fast again in the entry of 2025-11-18. Lifecycle applies to the xAI API; no source states when it left the consumer apps. No deprecation notice date is given. Input and output modalities are left out, and multimodal is not set: the archived API model page that lists them could not be opened for this review, and the announcement does not state image input for the model itself.
